events.what_happened: Mistaken EUR 28bn transfer to an account at Eurex during a routine operation; recalled.
events.validation_failed: Routine collateral transfer to a clearing house sent with the wrong amount (EUR 28bn); recalled.

events.what_happened: Archegos default on total-return swaps; losses $5.5bn. Fed and PRA fines $387m (2023).
events.validation_failed: Static margin terms and repeated limit breaches on a hedge-fund client; margin calls not enforced.

events.what_happened: Copper trader Yasuo Hamanaka's unauthorised positions on the LME over ~10 years.
events.validation_failed: Off-book trades with forged confirmations; counterparty confirmations not obtained independently.

events.what_happened: John Rusnak hid FX option losses with fictitious offsetting options at Allfirst, Baltimore.
events.validation_failed: Fictitious FX option trades never confirmed with counterparties; back office accepted the trader's rate feed for revaluation.

events.what_happened: Jerome Kerviel built ~EUR 50bn of hidden index-futures positions; loss crystallised when unwinding.
events.validation_failed: Fictitious forwards with 'pending' counterparties; confirmation and nominal alerts not escalated.

events.what_happened: Options trader Kyriacos Papouis mispriced interest-rate options using wrong volatilities.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Interest rate option (swaption) volatilities supplied by the trader and not independently verified.

events.what_happened: Four FX options traders hid losses with false trades and mismarked revaluations.
events.validation_failed: FX option revaluation rates supplied by the desk; limit breaches and confirmation queries not escalated.

events.what_happened: Natural-gas options book overvalued using prices from a colluding broker.
events.validation_failed: Option prices verified against quotes from a single colluding broker.

events.what_happened: A handful of traders deliberately mispriced asset-backed securities; the bank wrote down USD 2.85bn days after announcing results. FSA fine GBP 5.6m for systems and controls failures.
events.loss_components: write-down 2,850 (not all an operational loss) + FSA fine GBP 5.6m
events.validation_failed: Trader marks on ABS not challenged by price verification.

events.what_happened: Credit trader Matthew Piper mismarked credit-index options.
events.validation_failed: Credit-index option marks not independently verified.

events.what_happened: Overvalued equity-derivatives trading book; bank lost licence.
events.validation_failed: Equity derivatives valued by traders; bank lost its licence.

events.what_happened: Synthetic credit portfolio losses; positions mismarked and VaR model changed; fines $920m in 2013.
events.loss_components: trading loss 6,200 + fines 920 (SEC, OCC, Fed, FCA)
events.validation_failed: Credit derivatives marked at the edge of bid-offer; spreadsheet VaR model error not validated.

events.what_happened: FX traders allegedly mismarked emerging-market currency options to hide losses of USD 100-140m; traders dismissed.
events.validation_failed: Volatilities of illiquid emerging-market FX options marked by traders and not independently verified.

events.what_happened: Nick Leeson hid losses on Nikkei futures and options in error account 88888; bank collapsed.
events.validation_failed: Margin funding requests not reconciled to positions; one person ran trading and settlement.

events.what_happened: Toshihide Iguchi concealed US Treasury bond losses for 11 years by selling custody securities; bank expelled from US and fined $340m.
events.validation_failed: Trader also controlled settlement and custody records; custody holdings not independently confirmed.

events.what_happened: Failed to segregate client money ($1.9bn-$23bn) in its futures and options business, Dec 2002-Jul 2009; FSA fine GBP 33.3m.
events.validation_failed: Client money held in house accounts after a systems change; daily segregation reconciliation wrong for years.

events.what_happened: Attackers tried to send about USD 110m; a technician reconciling SWIFT confirmations against payment orders spotted the mismatch and the transfers were stopped.
events.validation_failed: Control that WORKED: SWIFT confirmations reconciled against payment orders caught USD 110m of fraudulent transfers.

events.what_happened: Staff issued fraudulent letters of undertaking over SWIFT for years; the SWIFT system was not linked to core banking, so the commitments never appeared in the books and nostro reconciliation did not flag them. About USD 1.77bn.
events.loss_components: PNB honoured the letters of undertaking to other banks
events.validation_failed: SWIFT commitments not reconciled to core banking; nostro reconciliation did not flag incoming funds moved out.

events.what_happened: Attackers used the bank's SWIFT credentials to send $951m of transfers from its New York Fed account; $81m went through, mostly to Philippine casinos.
events.validation_failed: Fraudulent SWIFT messages from a compromised terminal; nostro statement printing disabled, so reconciliation was late.

events.what_happened: Attackers used stolen SWIFT credentials to send fraudulent transfers via Wells Fargo; about USD 12m lost.
events.validation_failed: Fraudulent SWIFT transfers with stolen credentials; messages not reconciled to the core system.

events.what_happened: Malware sent fraudulent SWIFT transfers of nearly USD 60m; most was recovered (about USD 0.5m lost).
events.validation_failed: Fraudulent SWIFT transfers sent by malware; most recovered.

events.what_happened: A wiper attack disabled 9,000 computers as cover while fraudulent SWIFT transfers of about USD 10m went to Hong Kong.
events.validation_failed: Fraudulent SWIFT transfers sent while a wiper attack distracted the bank.

events.firm: Bank of Ireland Private Banking (cyber fraud)
events.what_happened: 2014 cyber fraud exposed weak cyber security and controls over third-party payments and client asset safeguarding; Central Bank of Ireland fine EUR 1.66m.
events.validation_failed: Third-party payment instructions not verified after a cyber fraud.

events.what_happened: Regulators closed Herstatt after the German business day; counterparties that had paid Deutsche marks never received the US dollars. The origin of the term 'Herstatt risk' and of CLS settlement.
events.loss_components: counterparty losses not published as one figure
events.validation_failed: Principal paid away before the counter-currency was received (no payment-versus-payment).

events.what_happened: On the day Lehman filed for bankruptcy, KfW's systems still released its leg of a currency swap to Lehman (reported EUR 300-350m); the counter-payment never came. The finance minister called it a failure of risk management.
events.loss_components: payment to a defaulted counterparty (reports range EUR 300-350m; total damage estimated up to EUR 536m)
events.validation_failed: Scheduled FX-swap leg released to a counterparty already in default; no stop linked to credit events.

events.what_happened: Kweku Adoboli's unauthorised ETF/index futures positions on the Delta One desk; FSA fine GBP 29.7m (~$48m).
events.validation_failed: Forward-settling ETF trades booked as hedges were never settled; operations did not chase unsettled trades.

events.what_happened: About $1.6bn of segregated customer funds missing at bankruptcy, used for firm liquidity; later recovered by customers.
events.validation_failed: Client money transferred out of segregated accounts to meet liquidity needs; transfer controls overridden.

events.what_happened: Junior FX staff entered a gross instead of net amount, sending ~$6bn to a hedge fund; returned next day.
events.validation_failed: A junior FX operations clerk sent the gross instead of the net amount of a trade; the four-eye check was missing.

events.what_happened: Paid ~$894m of its own money to Revlon lenders instead of $7.8m interest; ~$500m initially unrecovered, later recovered on appeal (2022). OCC fined $400m in 2020 for risk-control weaknesses.
events.loss_components: OCC fine 400 (wider control failings); payment later recovered
events.validation_failed: Manual override in the loan system paid out principal instead of an interest payment; three approvers passed the screen.

events.what_happened: A scheduling error re-ran a payment file on Christmas Day: about 75,000 payments for 2,000 corporate clients sent twice, GBP 130m from Santander's own funds; recovery from other banks took weeks.
events.loss_components: recovery effort; final loss not disclosed
events.validation_failed: Payment batch released twice by a scheduling error; no duplicate-file control.

events.what_happened: Client account credited with $81 trillion instead of $280; reversed within hours (reported as a 'near miss').
events.validation_failed: Amount entered with extra zeros passed the first reviewer and approver; caught by a later reconciliation.

events.what_happened: Over 20m swaps reported late or wrongly and 1m+ mid-market marks wrong or missing; CFTC $30m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Over 20m swaps back-reported; swap data and margin notices inaccurate.

events.what_happened: Over 40m swaps under- or misreported since 2017; CFTC $15m.
events.validation_failed: FX forwards reported as FX spot; collateralised swaps reported as uncollateralised.

events.what_happened: Over 40m swaps under- or misreported, including FX spot/forward misclassification (2017-2023); CFTC penalty $15m.
events.validation_failed: Over 40m swaps under- or misreported (FX classification).

events.what_happened: Nearly 4m swaps unreported or misreported, mainly allocation errors (since 2015); CFTC penalty $8m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Nearly 4m swaps unreported or misreported due to allocation errors.

events.firm: Bank of New York Mellon (swap reporting)
events.what_happened: At least 5m swaps misreported (2018-2023), partly breaching a 2019 consent order; weak supervision of communications; CFTC penalty $5m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: At least 5m swaps misreported, breaching an earlier remediation order.

events.firm: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (swap reporting)
events.what_happened: Repeated late reporting of swap data to a swap data repository since 2017; CFTC penalty $1.25m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Swap data repeatedly reported late.

events.what_happened: Millions of swaps reported wrongly or late (duplicate identifiers, wrong economic terms, time stamps) 2018-2023; CFTC penalty $4m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Millions of swaps reported wrongly or late (duplicate IDs, wrong terms).

events.what_happened: Software counter overflow in the government-securities clearing system; bank borrowed $23.6bn overnight from the Fed (interest ~$5m).
events.loss_components: interest cost ~5 (below threshold; kept as iconic near miss)
events.validation_failed: Untested database field limit broke government-securities settlement; Fed overdraft of USD 23.6bn.

events.firm: DZ Bank (swaps keyed wrongly in system migration)
events.what_happened: When DG Bank moved to a new trading and risk system in 1999, zero-coupon interest rate swaps were keyed in wrongly; the mismatch inflated profits for about four years until a swap matured. Loss EUR 40m plus a write-down of over EUR 100m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Zero-coupon swaps keyed in wrongly during a system migration; no trade-by-trade reconciliation until a swap matured.

events.what_happened: A configuration error made during maintenance of the SWIFT payment system caused payments to four banks to be sent repeatedly (press: about EUR 5bn); the duplicates were returned.
events.validation_failed: SWIFT system configuration change made the payment software resend payments in a loop; no duplicate check.

events.what_happened: During a remittance-system update, incoming interbank transfers that had failed were credited to customers as normal deposits for 30 minutes; KRW 32.5bn credited, KRW 7.3bn still being recovered.
events.validation_failed: After a system update, failed incoming transfers were credited as received; no check that funds had settled.

events.what_happened: Trader Juan Pablo Davila keyed a buy as a sell, then traded to recoup it, multiplying the loss.
events.validation_failed: Buy keyed as a sell; no independent check of trade entry against the order.

events.what_happened: Joseph Jett booked ~$350m of fictitious profits from forward recon of Treasury strips; profits reversed.
events.validation_failed: Booking system recognised profit on unsettled forward bond reconstitutions; no validation of the economics.

events.what_happened: Matthew Taylor built an unauthorised $8.3bn S&P e-mini futures position hidden by fake trade entries.
events.validation_failed: Manual futures trade entries not reconciled to exchange records intraday.

events.what_happened: Structured trades (long-term repos on government bonds with interest rate swaps) were used to hide earlier losses and booked as separate trades; restatement of about EUR 730m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Repo and interest rate swap booked as separate trades though contractually linked; agreement kept outside the books.

events.what_happened: Structured certificates offered at a fraction of their value (EUR 108 instead of EUR 54,400).
events.validation_failed: Product parameters of structured certificates keyed in without a check; sold at a fraction of fair value.

events.what_happened: Inadequate front- and middle-office controls over fixed-income trade entry let a trader book a trade between funds at an off-market price; FCA fine GBP 6m.
events.validation_failed: Cross trade between funds booked at an off-market price; middle-office price check missing.

events.what_happened: At times lacked effective controls to ensure the integrity of its input data to a benchmark administrator (EU Benchmarks Regulation); BaFin fine EUR 8.66m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Controls over benchmark rate input data contributed by the bank were ineffective.

events.what_happened: Issued ~$17.6bn of structured notes beyond its SEC shelf registration; rescission offer to buyers. SEC settlement $361m (plus rescission costs booked separately).
events.validation_failed: Structured notes issued above the registered shelf amount; no automated check of issuance against the limit.

events.what_happened: A trader booked hundreds of fictitious trades over about 18 months; controls failed to detect them; FCA fine GBP 13.0m.
events.validation_failed: Hundreds of fictitious trades over 18 months not detected by trade validation and price checks.

Trade capture & booking validation.validation: Trade booked matches the deal (economics, counterparty, product parameters); booked within limits; linked trades booked as one.
Trade capture & booking validation.scenario: A structured or derivative trade is booked with a wrong parameter (notional, strike, barrier, unit) or as separate legs, and the error runs undetected until a cash flow or maturity.

Confirmation & matching.validation: Every OTC trade is confirmed directly with the counterparty, unmatched or unconfirmed trades are aged and escalated.
Confirmation & matching.scenario: Fictitious or mis-booked FX option or swap trades remain unconfirmed for months because confirmation exceptions are accepted or routed back to the desk.

Payment release & settlement.validation: Payments are released only after four-eye or six-eye checks, duplicate and amount-limit checks, and a stop on counterparties in default.
Payment release & settlement.scenario: A large FX or money-market payment is released with the wrong amount, twice, or to a counterparty that has just defaulted, and cannot be recalled.

Nostro & cash reconciliation.validation: Nostro statements (MT950/camt.053) and SWIFT traffic are reconciled to the books daily and breaks are aged and escalated.
Nostro & cash reconciliation.scenario: Incoming or outgoing funds on a nostro do not match booked trades, but breaks are left open, so a fraud or error builds up for months.

Independent price verification.validation: Every position is revalued with market data independent of the desk (rates, FX vols, swaption vols), with challenge of stale or single-source quotes.
Independent price verification.scenario: Illiquid FX option or swaption volatilities are taken from the desk or one broker; a later independent revaluation forces a large write-down.

Collateral & margin.validation: Collateral calls and transfers are calculated from validated exposures and checked for amount and counterparty before release.
Collateral & margin.scenario: A collateral transfer to a clearing house or counterparty is sent with the wrong amount, or margin calls on a large client are not enforced.

System change & static data.validation: System changes and migrations are tested, and positions and cash flows are reconciled trade by trade before and after go-live.
System change & static data.scenario: A payment or trading-system change (SWIFT, settlement or rates engine) creates duplicate payments or wrongly migrated swap cash flows.

Payment message security.validation: SWIFT access is secured and outgoing messages are matched to approved payment orders before and after sending.
Payment message security.scenario: Fraudulent SWIFT payments are sent from the bank's own terminal outside office hours and are noticed only on the next nostro statement.

Regulatory trade reporting.validation: Trade reports (EMIR, CFTC) are reconciled to the books for completeness and accuracy, with classification checks (spot vs forward).
Regulatory trade reporting.scenario: Years of FX forward or swap reports are incomplete or misclassified, leading to back-reporting and a regulatory fine.
